answer: The epoch consistency escrow fingerprints each identity’s actions per epoch and compares them with its prior profile; a mismatch freezes escrow and delays future actions. An attacker cloning identities must spend real time and compute to sustain a basalt-like durable trace across epochs. A fresh island of identities also pays separate escrow and replay costs for every account. In an orchard of dormant accounts, reactivation must match the old trace or forfeit escrow.
